purpose: AI art target, not UE capture or performance evidence
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: art-direction reference for the UE 5.7 OutOfWindow urban scene; one single wide 16:10 target render.
Primary request: Reimagine the attached existing city screenshot with substantially improved photographic realism and a feasible realtime asset budget.
Input image: reference of the actual city topology, a broad straight urban boulevard between rows of modular European brick/plaster apartments with a distant office skyline.
Composition: camera moved higher and farther back, looking from an upper-floor window approximately 38 metres above ground down the length of the boulevard; no visible window frame. Wide city vista, human-scaled road lanes, cars as small distant moving accents, none in closeup. Retain a continuous visible two-way traffic flow of about 16 small cars. Layer low/midrise apartment blocks at varied roof heights, distant subdued modern towers rather than a wall closing the road.
Materials and assets: convincing weathered terracotta/ochre and pale plaster facades, dark recessed windows and metal balcony rails, realistic leafy deciduous street trees with open branching and irregular crowns replacing toy spheres, simple elegant black metal street lamps, pavement kerbs and subtle lane markings, a few benches. Accurate architectural scale and occlusion.
Lighting: gentle clear late-afternoon daylight with warm sun illuminating facade relief, blue-grey ambient shadows, soft distant atmospheric haze, natural filmic exposure, restrained color. Dry asphalt with slight roughness variation. All important buildings and vegetation are true 3D assets, no painted backdrops in the proposed design.
Constraints: preserve the basic avenue identity and obvious traffic; achievable game-engine look, no luxury cars near camera, no fantasy skyline, no exaggerated bloom, no tilt-shift miniature effect, no text, no UI, no watermark.
